changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Retires the five practices of the first seed, which repeat catalog practices. Only rows with an unedited definition change. A row with no review history goes. A row with history stays with its results: Reviewed by Nobody stops new reviews, and feedback Off stops what was not delivered.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup and start the previous release. Deleted seed practices had no review history, so nothing about a person is lost.
